    • findGraceRevocationCandidates

      public List<ApiKeyCredential> findGraceRevocationCandidates(String env)
      Return the credentials in the given environment eligible for automated grace-period revocation (IGDD-2711): status == "grace_period", a non-null graceExpiresAt, and graceExpiresAt <= now.

      On renewal, Config Console moves the superseded (old) key to grace_period with a graceExpiresAt (IGDD-2707); it keeps authenticating alongside the new key until that instant passes, at which point this job revokes it. Normal active keys have no graceExpiresAt and are never selected. The query is environment-scoped via the {env}# sort-key prefix, then filtered in memory (design D4).

      Parameters:
      env - the environment to scope the query to (sort-key prefix {env}#)
      Returns:
      the grace-period credentials whose grace period has expired; never null

    • revokeIfGracePeriod

      public boolean revokeIfGracePeriod(ApiKeyCredential credential, Instant revokedAt, String revokedBy)
      Atomically revoke a credential only if it is still in grace_period, so that when multiple Hub instances run the sweep concurrently a given key is revoked — and therefore audited — exactly once. Uses a conditional DynamoDB update (condition: status = "grace_period"); the losing instances get a condition failure and do nothing.
      Parameters:
      credential - the grace-period candidate to revoke
      revokedAt - the revocation timestamp
      revokedBy - the revoking actor (e.g. system:grace-revocation)
      Returns:
      true if this call performed the revocation; false if the condition failed (another instance already revoked it, or its status is no longer grace_period)
